project_type: Next.js 16.4.2 App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Supabase (service-role client), NextAuth v4 JWT sessions
build_system: Next.js 16 with npm; build command is `next build`. No monorepo. All source under src/. Path alias @/ maps to src/.
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm run build` from /Users/Apple/code/clients/kazi — must exit 0 with no type errors. 2. Run `npm run lint` — no new errors. 3. Spot-check affected routes exist at the correct paths.
environment_constraints: Do NOT restart the dev server. Do NOT push to remote. Do NOT expose secrets. .env.local must only add SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL= as an empty placeholder at the bottom of the # Slack section.
contribution_requirements: Match existing code style: Tailwind, var(--border), var(--surface), var(--text-hi/lo), brand-500 (#f05d23), solar: iconify icons (broken variant). All API routes gate by role using can() from src/lib/rbac.ts. DB migrations go in supabase/migrations/ with timestamp prefix. Do not modify unrelated code.

key_patterns.auth_gating: const session = await getServerSession(authOptions); if (!session) return 401; if (!can(session.user.role, 'permission')) return 403;
key_patterns.route_context: type RouteContext = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }; export async function HANDLER(req, { params }: RouteContext) { const { id } = await params; }
key_patterns.supabase: import { supabaseAdmin } from '@/lib/supabase'; — always use supabaseAdmin for server-side operations
key_patterns.modal_pattern: SimpleModal from @/components/ui/SimpleModal; Button from @/components/ui/Button; useTransition for async handlers; toast from react-hot-toast
key_patterns.integration_card_pattern: IntegrationCard in IntegrationsClient.tsx — pass status='connected'|'disconnected', onConnect, onDisconnect. All state in useState. Reload after connect via window.location (as Asana does) or router.refresh() after disconnect.
key_patterns.wallet_award_pattern: upsert reward_wallets {user_id, balance: 0} ignoring duplicate; then UPDATE reward_wallets SET balance = balance + N WHERE user_id = ?; then INSERT reward_ledger {user_id, amount: N, reason, reference_type, reference_id, created_by}
key_patterns.migration_naming: supabase/migrations/20261023000NNN_name.sql — last existing is 20261023000016_leaderboard_opt_in.sql, so next is 20261023000017
key_patterns.server_component_page: async function Page() { const session = await getServerSession(authOptions); ... return <FeatureComponent data={data} />; } — page.tsx is a server component, heavy logic in src/features/*/components/
key_patterns.sidebar_nav: Add NavItem to sidebarNavGroups in src/lib/nav.ts under the relevant category object's items array

directory_structure: src/app/(app)/ — all authenticated page routes; src/app/api/ — all API route handlers; src/features/ — heavy component logic, co-located by feature; src/lib/ — shared utilities (auth, supabase, rbac, nav, notifications); src/types/database.ts — single source of truth for DB types; supabase/migrations/ — sequential SQL migrations
